we have compiled a massive, multilinguall dictionary that contains 4.2 times as many translations as in the largest Wikitionary at precision 90% and 10.5 times as many as in the second largest Wiktionary, that this dictionary contains more than 200,000.000 pairwise translations in 1,000,000 language pairs, and that this dictionary is 10 times as large as the largest existing multilingual dictionary.

1) We can automatically compose a large, multilingual dictionary that contains more translations than any of its constituent translation dictionaries; 2) We can automatically infer a translation between two languages if we have a translation dictionary for each of the two languages and a set of translation dictionaries between each pair of languages; 3) We can automatically solve the problem of transitive inference for a set of translation dictionary; 4) We can infer translations between languages that are not directly connected by a translation dictionary
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of how to compose multiple translation dictionaries into a single massive dictionary.
the following questions: (1) Can we automatically compose multiple dictionaries to yield a large dictionary with greater coverage?
the problem of how to compose multiple dictionaries into a single, large multilingual dictionary.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is the first one which allows to create a large-scale multilingual dictionary from a set of translation dictionaries.
the algorithm presented in this paper is the first one that is able to compose a large number of translation dictionaries to yield an even larger one with substantially better coverage.

the algorithm introduced by this paper is a novel and effective method for the composition of a massive, multilinguall dictionary from a set of smaller dictionaries, and PANDICTIONARy is the largest dictionary ever composed by a machine.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have created the world’s largest, most comprehensive dictionary, which is also available as open source software.
we have developed a new algorithm for probabilistic inference over transitive relations and have applied this algorithm to the problem of compiling a large, multilingual dictionary.
we have developed an approach that enables the automatic construction of a massive multilingual dictionary that is substantially more complete than the best existing dictionaries.
